text.title: Analog Devices IC operations: QIP goals to 1992
text.strategy: Business objectives: market leadership, revenue growth, profitability. Driver: be rated number 1 by customers in total value delivered
text.m1: N/A: no financial measure on the slides read
text.t1: N/A: no financial target on the slides read
text.g2: Be rated number 1 by customers in total value delivered
text.m2: On-time delivery; outgoing defect level; lead time; share of customer requested dates (CRDs) matched; excess lead time
text.t2: 1987 / 1990 / 1992 goal: delivery 85% / 96% / >99.8%; defects 500 / 230 / <10 PPM; lead time 10 / 5.4 / <3 weeks; CRDs matched 31% / 50% / n/a
text.g3: Eliminate all forms of waste at all entities, functions and levels
text.m3: Manufacturing cycle time; process defect level; yield
text.t3: 1987 / 1990 / 1992 goal: cycle time 15 / 8 / 4-5 weeks; process defects 5000 / 1100 / <10 PPM; yield 20% / 38% / >50%
text.g4: Shorter time to market; reduced turnover
text.m4: Time to market; labor turnover as a proxy for employee satisfaction; from FY1990 bookings of products introduced after 1985
text.t4: Time to market 1987 / 1990 / 1992 goal: 36 months / not read / 6 months; turnover target not read
text.decision: FY1990: delivery is measured against the customer's requested date; the old new-product measures, poor predictors, are replaced by a product tracking system and two innovation measures. FY1991-92: scorecard unchanged
